Class Tokenizer

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.tokenizer.Tiktoken
smile.llm.model.qwen.Tokenizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tokenizer
public class Tokenizer extends Tiktoken
Qwen3.5 chat tokenizer (byte-level BPE via Tiktoken).

Loads from a checkpoint directory. Prefers HuggingFace tokenizer.json (includes added_tokens with the real <|im_start|> / <|im_end|> ids) over vocab.json alone.

    • of

      public static Tokenizer of(String checkpointDir) throws IOException
      Loads a tokenizer from a HuggingFace checkpoint directory.

      Order matters: tokenizer.json is preferred because it carries added_tokens with the true chat special ids. Loading vocab.json alone and then appending specials at maxId+1 remaps <|im_start|> past vocab_size and crashes embedding gather on GPU.

      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - model directory.
      Returns:
      tokenizer instance.
      Throws:
      IOException - if no supported tokenizer files are found.

    • loadTokenizerJson

      public static Map<Bytes,Integer> loadTokenizerJson(Path tokenizerJson) throws IOException

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      token byte sequence → id map (GPT-2 keys converted to raw bytes).
